name: piggybank
description: PiggyBank: a piggy bank wallet for Solana, as a Chrome extension. Save toward goals in jars, lock savings until you reach them, swap SOL, USDC and USDT.

scripts.test: node --import ./test/register-jsx.mjs test/core.test.mjs && node --import ./test/register-jsx.mjs test/locker.test.mjs && node --import ./test/register-jsx.mjs test/jupiter-lock.test.mjs && node --import ./test/register-jsx.mjs test/swap.test.mjs && node test/rpc.test.mjs && node test/deposits.test.mjs && node test/poison.test.mjs && node --import ./test/register-jsx.mjs scripts/check_i18n.mjs
scripts.pack: vite build && rm -f piggybank-extension.zip && cd dist && zip -qr -X ../piggybank-extension.zip . -x '_metadata/*'
scripts.e2e: python3 test/e2e.py && node test/verify_txs.mjs && python3 test/e2e_drag.py && python3 test/e2e_security.py && python3 test/e2e_money.py && python3 test/e2e_swap.py && node test/verify_swaps.mjs && python3 test/e2e_langs.py
